links.outcome: Accuracy of genetic variant annotations from RAG grounding versus fine-tuning
links.effect: RAG with 190 million curated variant annotations gave accurate annotations and outperformed fine-tuning on data volume, accuracy and cost. Fine-tuning improved only some fields, and accuracy across more fields remained suboptimal.
links.quote: Our project also revealed that RAG outperforms fine-tuning in factual knowledge injection in terms of data volume, accuracy, and cost-effectiveness.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning an LLM on domain-specific variant annotation data to inject factual knowledge

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to an existing LLM, compared with fine-tuning
screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) added to an LLM versus fine-tuning to ground genomic variant interpretations and reduce hallucinations.
